overview.body1: The Garden Junior Suite is an intimate 1-bedroom retreat with a four-poster king bed, a kitchenette, and a private patio that opens directly to the tropical garden. Ideal for couples or solo travellers seeking a quiet, private escape.
overview.body2: Thoughtfully designed with every comfort in mind, the Garden Junior Suite offers the charm of a boutique villa with the convenience of a self-contained space — perfect for longer stays.
